# Blora Design 2.0

> Token-driven, accessible, zero-dependency Web UI design system (npm `@bloret-crew/blora-design`).
> This file is the entry point for AI agents that migrate or build pages with Blora.

## Read in this order

1. `docs/patterns.md` — page composition rules and ten copy-ready page patterns. Read it before writing any page.
2. `docs/migration/from-any-ui-to-blora-design.md` — the complete migration standard: replacement matrix and a verified example for every component and add-on.
3. `docs/standards.md` — the real token names and visual rules.
4. `packages/blora-design/contracts/*.contract.json` — the only source of truth for attributes, slots, events and classes.

Inside an installed project the same documents ship with the package: `node_modules/@bloret-crew/blora-design/llms.txt` and `node_modules/@bloret-crew/blora-design/dist/docs/`.

## Hard rules

- Import `@bloret-crew/blora-design/blora.css` and `@bloret-crew/blora-design/auto`; use published npm exports only (never repository `src/` paths or copied component code).
- Declare `@layer legacy, blora;` before every stylesheet and move all legacy/global CSS into `@layer legacy`. Unlayered `button {}`, `input {}`, `a {}` or `* {}` rules override every Blora component.
- Page CSS only does layout. Colours come from `--blora-color-*` tokens; names such as `--blora-primary`, `--blora-surface-1` or `--blora-text-muted` do not exist.
- One surface level: page → `.blora-card`. Never put cards inside cards; use lists, descriptions, dividers or `data-variant="inset"`.
- Status uses `.blora-badge` / `.blora-tag` variants (`success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`, `neutral`); never hand-coloured chips.
- One primary button per region; secondary actions `outline`/`ghost`; destructive actions `danger` plus `<blora-popconfirm>`.
- Forms use `<blora-field>`; controls use the Blora element (`<blora-select>`, `<blora-switch>`, `<blora-checkbox>`, `<blora-datepicker>` …), not bare native controls.
- Icons: `data-icon="name"` on `.blora-button`, `.blora-badge` or an empty `<span>` (Lucide names); no emoji or glyph icons.
- Every data region has loading (`.blora-skeleton`), empty (`<blora-empty>`) and error (`<blora-alert>`) states; feedback uses `message`, never `alert()`/`confirm()`.
- Use only attributes declared in the contracts. Do not author `blora-<component>__*` internals or invent `blora-*` classes.

## Verify

- `npx blora-lint src` (2.1.0+) must report zero errors.
- Check every page in light and dark mode, two themes and a 390px viewport.

## Repository

- `docs/guide.md` — usage guide
- `docs/framework.md` — framework integration
- `examples/showcase-v2/` — interactive catalogue of every component (the rendering reference)
- `pnpm verify` — full gate for changes to this repository

The complete migration standard is `docs/migration/from-any-ui-to-blora-design.md`.
